xmldoc.short_description: Display stream paths with ribbon-like line styling.

syntax.syntax_item: streamribbon(U, V, W, sx, sy, sz)
streamribbon(X, Y, Z, U, V, W, sx, sy, sz)

description.p: streamribbon displays 3-D stream paths as ribbon surfaces.
streamribbon(vertices, twistangle) uses precomputed streamline vertices and a cell array of twist angles. The returned handles are surface objects.

example_item.example_item_description: Display a stream ribbon style path.
